top.title: Acoramidis Associated with Significantly Improved Clinical Outcomes Versus Tafamidis in ATTR-CM in an Independent, Real-World Study of U.S. Electronic Health Records
top.summary: An independent real-world study of 2,684 ATTR-CM patients from U.S. electronic health records found that acoramidis was associated with an 18% lower risk of death, hospitalization, atrial fibrillation, and diuretic intensification compared to tafamidis. Acoramidis showed 27% lower risk of cardiovascular and heart failure hospitalizations. These findings replicate earlier comparative effectiveness analyses and support acoramidis as a preferred stabilizer treatment option.

top.title: Encaleret Increased Bone Turnover and Improved Participant-Reported Symptoms in the Phase 3 CALIBRATE Trial in ADH1
top.summary: BridgeBio announced positive Phase 3 CALIBRATE trial results for encaleret in autosomal dominant hypocalcemia type 1 (ADH1), showing 91% of participants achieved normal PTH levels compared to 0% on standard care, with 100% reporting symptom improvements versus 46% on conventional therapy. The FDA accepted the NDA with Priority Review (PDUFA date May 8, 2027), and the company initiated the Phase 3 RECLAIM-HP trial for chronic hypoparathyroidism.

top.summary: Winseed concluded its participation at IAA TRANSPORTATION 2026 in Hanover, highlighting the shift of automotive AI from innovation to commercialization. Winseed emphasizes that future automotive leaders must compete on both technological innovation and ensuring that innovation is accurately understood in international markets.

top.title: MannKind Data at HFSA 2026 Highlights New Evidence Supporting Furoscix ReadyFlow™ for the Outpatient Management of Edema in Heart Failure (HF) and Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD)
top.summary: MannKind Corporation announced new clinical data for Furoscix ReadyFlow, an autoinjector delivering IV-equivalent diuretic therapy for heart failure and chronic kidney disease. Presented at the HFSA 2026 Annual Scientific Meeting, the data demonstrates comparable urine output to IV furosemide, consistent bioavailability across injection sites, and seamless transition capabilities from the previous On-body Infusor formulation. The product received FDA approval in July 2026 and is designed to enable earlier outpatient intervention for fluid overload management.
